rules.statement: The dismissal of a case based on the wrong registration of lis pendens, where there was no contest and no argument, violates natural justice.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) It was not open to the District Judge to dismiss the case on the point of wrong registration of the lis pendens - a point on which there was no contest and no argument was heard. It is a violation of natural justice. (2) The lis pendens being registered in the folios where the deeds of the Sand described in the plaint were registered was correctly registered.
